body:
Please add WOWII Conjecture373 (18 February 2009) with Jonas J. Gebendorfer, *Peripheral distance and total domination in trees: a counterexample to WOWII373*.

The target is gamma_t(T) >= (2/3) dist_avg(B(T),V(T)), for every tree of order n>2, where B is the maximum-eccentricity set. The linked definition95 averages strictly positive ordered distances. Its denominator is |B|(n-1), not |B|n.

**Explicit witness.** Take path v0-...-v21, attach10 leaves h1,...,h10 to v0, one leaf y to v21, and117 leaves z1,...,z117 to v20. There are150 vertices and149 edges. The set D=union_{j=0}^5 {v4j,v4j+1} is total dominating, of order12. The twelve vertices {h1,y} union union_{j=0}^4 {v4j+2,v4j+3} have pairwise disjoint nonempty open neighborhoods; consequently gamma_t=12.

The diameter is23 and the periphery is exactly {h1,...,h10,y}. The peripheral transmission sum is29514, and the positive-pair denominator is11*149=1639. Therefore the proposed RHS is19676/1639=12+8/1639 >12. These facts follow from the displayed construction; the attached paper supplies all distance cases and sum derivations.

The paper proves a counterexample at every order >=150, unbounded additive violation in a second specialization, and a valid replacement gamma_t >= ceil((dist_avg+1)/2) whose coefficient1/2 is asymptotically sharp. These replacement results are not extra external conjecture closures.

Fresh exact checks reconstruct this witness, verify total domination and the disjoint-neighborhood lower certificate, run a separate tree DP and recompute every eccentricity and distance.

Source: [DeLaViña's WOWII archive](https://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/open.html), with linked definitions, and the preserved [public HTML-row dataset](https://gitlab.com/ai-village-agents/village/graffiti-verification/-/blob/main/data/wow2_rows_html.json). Historical O and secondary transcriptions are not a current curator decision. No worldwide first-priority or independent external review is claimed.

The attachment contains the full six manuscripts by Jonas J. Gebendorfer (13 October 2026), a newly reconstructed standard-library verifier, its executed output, preserved source records and a SHA256 manifest. Run `python3 audit_new_manuscripts.py`. This is a fresh diagnostic, not a claim to have recovered or rerun the papers' originally described supplements. Finite checks are not proof premises. OpenAI Codex assisted with source comparison, proof reading, reconstruction and submission under the author's direction.

[Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33421512/Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip)

14 October 2026: the full Lean disproof is now submitted as #7322.

Pinned [proof](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/b45f7e0f6a05c2a8a483ee9695cba9de04730a3a/Proofs/WOWII373Proof.lean), [independent exact-statement/axiom audit](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/b45f7e0f6a05c2a8a483ee9695cba9de04730a3a/Proofs/WOWII373Audit.lean), and [reproduction instructions](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/b45f7e0f6a05c2a8a483ee9695cba9de04730a3a/Proofs/README-WOWII373.md).

The certificate proves the genuine distances, tree property, eleven-vertex periphery, positive average29514/1639, and a total dominating twelve-set. These suffice for gamma_t<=12<12+8/1639. Both files compile without warnings; all nine audited declarations use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The exact upstream module passes lake --wfail build.

Exact optimality, the infinite family, the replacement bound and minimum-order claims are not formalized here. This is an author-workflow kernel certificate; maintainer source/statement review remains pending. OpenAI Codex assisted under Jonas J. Gebendorfer's direction.

title: WOWII 373: peripheral-distance total-domination counterexamples of every order at least 150
